item.title: Sector Update: Healthcare Stocks Softer Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:49 PM EDT, 09/09/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Healthcare stocks were lower late Wednesday afternoon with the NYSE Healthcare Index and the State Street Health
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:49 PM EDT, 09/09/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Healthcare stocks were lower late Wednesday afternoon with the NYSE Healthcare Index and the State Street Health Care Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLV) each shedding 0.2%. The iShares Biotechnology ETF (IBB) declined 0.8%. In corporate news, UnitedHealth (UNH) sold an interest in some of its Optum Health operations in Florida to TPG (TPG), Bloomberg reported. UnitedHealth shares were down 2.2%. Agilent Technologies (A) shares fell 1.2% after UBS downgraded the stock to neutral from buy. Rezolute (RZLT) said Wednesday that the US Food and Drug Administration is still reviewing data from a phase 3 study of ersodetug for the potential treatment of hypoglycemia due to congenital hyperinsulinism. The company said it does not have a specific timeline on when it will receive feedback or guidance from the FDA on potential next steps. Rezolute shares were down past 7%. Opus Genetics (IRD) shares jumped 35% after it said that patients with Bestrophin-1-related retinal diseases showed clinically meaningful improvement in visual function in the low-dose cohort 1 of its BIRD-1 phase 1/2 trial evaluating OPGx-BEST1.

item.title: Sector Update: Tech Stocks Ease Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:46 PM EDT, 09/09/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks eased late Wednesday afternoon with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) little c
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:46 PM EDT, 09/09/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks eased late Wednesday afternoon with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) little changed after erasing earlier gains and the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) dropping 0.2%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index rose 0.2%. In corporate news, Apple (AAPL) introduced iPhone Duo, its first foldable iPhone, featuring a 7.6-inch inner display and 5.4-inch outer display, both using Super Retina XDR technology. Apple shares fell 0.2%. Dell Technologies (DELL) is set to raise $5 billion via an investment-grade bond sale that attracted about $23 billion in peak orders, Bloomberg reported. Dell shares were little changed. Meta Platforms (META) launched a new personal AI agent called Muse AI, which can send emails, book travel plans, and continue working after users close the app. Meta shares jumped 6.4%. Analog Devices (ADI) agreed to buy Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion in cash to add AI-native microcontrollers and fusion processors. Analog Devices shares eased 0.1%.

item.title: Benfica Futebol SAD calls shareholder meeting
item.description: Sport Lisboa e Benfica Futebol SAD will hold a shareholder meeting in Lisbon on Oct. 1, 2026. Shareholders will vote on adoption of the 2025/26 annual repor
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sport Lisboa e Benfica Futebol SAD will hold a shareholder meeting in Lisbon on Oct. 1, 2026. Shareholders will vote on adoption of the 2025/26 annual report and accounts. Board proposes allocating net profit of EUR 19.12 million, including EUR 18.17 million to retained earnings, EUR 956,153 to legal reserve. Meeting will consider a confidence vote in the management and supervisory bodies, including the statutory auditor, for the 2025/26 year. Items include amending the corporate purpose to add education, continuous training, technical consulting, innovation projects, partnerships in youth football and talent development. item.title: LithiumBank converts Boardwalk 10-6 well into lithium brine production asset in Alberta
item.description: LithiumBank completed the regulatory transfer of its 10-6 well at the Boardwalk lithium brine project in Alberta. The former oil well was re-designated as a
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: LithiumBank completed the regulatory transfer of its 10-6 well at the Boardwalk lithium brine project in Alberta. The former oil well was re-designated as a dedicated lithium brine production well, enabling direct brine production from the Devonian Leduc formation. The conversion supports a brownfield development strategy intended to cut upfront capex, reduce surface disturbance, and speed timelines toward commercial DLE production. The 10-6 well has supplied bulk brine for long-cycle DLE testing and battery-grade lithium carbonate conversion work. Separately, it granted 1,651,500 stock options at USD 0.75 per share, expiring Sept. 9, 2031.
